about:
G & E Steel Inc. operates from Salem, Massachusetts, serving the North Shore region of New England. The company was founded in 1976 by Antonio Ciasullo, an Italian‑American master artisan with decades of metalworking experience. After Ciasullo’s passing, his sons Gino and Emilio took over; Gino, a Bentley College graduate, serves as treasurer and chief operating officer, while Emilio, a Worcester Polytechnic Institute engineering graduate, holds the title of president and senior project manager. The business remains family‑owned and operated.

The shop specializes in custom stainless‑steel and carbon‑steel fabrication, producing railings, staircases, balconies, decks, and handicap‑accessible railings for both commercial and residential projects. Services cover the full project lifecycle: design assistance, field measurement, fabrication, delivery, and installation. The company also offers a one‑year warranty on fabricated work and provides free quotes. No facility size or employee count is published.

Customers include commercial contractors, private homeowners, and at least one federal agency (the United States Postal Service). The firm’s service area spans Salem, Swampscott, Marblehead, Gloucester, Newburyport, and surrounding Essex County communities.

G & E Steel positions itself as a one‑stop shop, handling every step from initial design through final installation. The founders’ emphasis on craftsmanship and the second generation’s engineering background are cited as the foundation of its reputation for reliable, custom metalwork.
